cues.text: You come into the dorm lounge with your bag. Mitsuru, Yukari, Junpei and Fuuka stand waiting for you.
Junpei folds his arms. Yukari steps forward, folds her arms and glares at him.
Mitsuru leads you all upstairs, to a quiet area with low tables and chairs, vending machines and a bookshelf at the back.
